title: Pseudo-coherent complexes
statement: For a scheme $Y$ [def-pc-scheme], an object $E$ of the derived category [def-pc-derived-category] $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ is pseudo-coherent if, locally on $Y$, it is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $\mathcal O_Y$-modules (equivalently, it is pseudo-coherent in the sense of Stacks Tag 08CB, i.e. $m$-pseudo-coherent for every $m$; on a scheme the two formulations agree by Stacks Tags 08E5 and 08E7).
